title: Depth of Market + Chart AI bot
author: i-hate-hand-trading
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/4down24k9pyh1.png

I'm trying Depth of Market (DOM) + normal chart (9, 20 EMA). The AI analyzes this and place a trade; so far it has been really good...

DOM shows the ask and bid price + other trades, you can filter be how many seconds. I'm using 15 seconds per interval.

https://i.redd.it/9pt02ki69pyh1.png

However, it still has noise and not perfect because the ask and bid ratio can change instantly... Your thoughts??
